effect_description_eng: ＜Training＞ (In the main phase, by suspending this Digimon, place your deck's top card face down as this Digimon's bottom digivolution card. This effect can also activate in the breeding area.)
inherited_effect_description_eng: ＜Raid＞ (When this Digimon attacks, you may switch the target of attack to 1 of your opponent's unsuspended Digimon with the highest DP.)
